paraphrase: Added scope premise, not attributed: every respect in which something is being moved, in the broad sense of the prima via (reduction from potency to act), is a respect of physical motion (place, quality or quantity). It is open and doubtful: on the case's broad reading of motus, reductions in understanding or willing are not physical motions, and then this premise is false.
